system.description:
Kishai Inheritance: a traded good. Legendary[1], Rot. 1 item slot. Attunement. Special Property: Spores.

Prerequisites: Wiles[4]

A small metal contraption, filled with gears and mechanisms. It looks like it can be turned along one axis, opening small openings all over the sides. It’s letting out such a pretty light!

Illusory Caster (Action): When you use the Staff of Spores, choose one target within 10ft of you, then roll 1D2. If you roll a 1, the caster gives Panic. If you roll a 2, the caster gives Taunt. Then, roll 1D6. The target rolls Courage Checks (Check DC13) against X levels of the Condition, where X is the result of your 1D6 check. Narratively, visible and strange illusions display before the target as you do this. You may use this item once per Quick Rest.

Rulebook p.74.
